watch_front: Use case: stylized-concept. Production sprite for the 1930s Shanghai pawnshop game 鬼市当铺. Input image 1 is the approved full-scene gouache STYLE reference only. The dial plane is already foreshortened naturally, with an oval silhouette, but the case has physical thickness and weight. Ivory/gray aged enamel dial, thin dark blued hands, fine black hour markers, a small restrained seconds subdial. Simple crown and bow pointing back-left, small fine-link chain lying slack in a compact irregular curve behind/right on the same plane, not suspended and not enormous.
